_comment: Private metadata for mlx-movie-director model registry. Created by convert.py or manually. Validated by `run.py check-manifests`. See docs/models.md for schema docs.
name: seedvr2-7b
description: SeedVR2 7B diffusion transformer for AI upscaling, 8-bit MLX quantized (GS=64), remapped from ComfyUI safetensors

cli.note: also used by: upscale, image expansion --upscale-method seedvr2, image restore

author_notes: Re-quantized to 8-bit MLX (GS=64) on 2026-06-22 from the Comfy-Org fp16 safetensors (upstream ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR2-7B); previously 4-bit (GS=32). The 8-bit build halves the quantization error at ~1.7x size (5.1 GB -> 8.8 GB). Loader reads bits/gs from this format field via _detect_quant_from_manifest (mlx-8bit -> 8/64).
